_note: What each battle status says on its card (ui/statuscard.ts). `until` replaces the rounds-left line for a status that doesn't count rounds. The numbers in `desc` are read from RULES in src/game/battle/fighter.ts (re-exported by rules.ts): keep them in step.

regen.name: Warming
regen.desc: Gets back a little health at the end of each round.

marked.name: Marked
marked.desc: Every hero hits it harder, and its weaknesses show.

deepcold.name: Deep Cold
deepcold.desc: Slower each round it holds, and Chilled afresh each round.

drawing.name: Drawing the blows
drawing.desc: Foes aiming at one hero aim here.

covered.name: Covered
covered.desc: Someone is taking the blows meant for them.

immune.name: Shrugging it off
immune.desc: What would hurt or hinder can't land for now.

sticky.name: Sticky
sticky.desc: Stuck in candy-glass: a little slower, and it can't dodge. If it tries to curl or bristle, it just struggles and loses the turn. Frost on top freezes it solid.

chilled.name: Chilled
chilled.desc: Acts last in the round. An earth spell shatters the chill for half again the damage.

frozen.name: Frozen
frozen.desc: Frozen solid: it loses its next turn, and can't be frozen again for a while after.

curled.name: Curled up
curled.desc: Rolled into a ball: its defense is more than doubled. An earth spell breaks it open.

wingspread.name: Wings spread
wingspread.desc: Wings out, wide as a door. Hit it with a physical attack and about a third of the blow comes back at you. Spells are safe. Sticky wings stick, and the turn is lost.
wingspread.until: Until it's hit or its next turn

bristling.name: Bristling
bristling.desc: Quills out. Hit it with a physical attack and about a third of the blow comes back at you. Spells are safe.
bristling.until: Until it's hit or its next turn

burning.name: Burning
burning.desc: Loses a little health at the end of each round. Fire wears it down, but won't finish it.

hexed.name: Hexed
hexed.desc: Under a hex: its blows land 40% softer and its armor rots a little, worse with each new hex, up to three.

cracked.name: Cracked
cracked.desc: Its guard has a crack in it: every hero's blows land 35% harder.

poison.name: Poisoned
poison.desc: Loses a little health at the end of each round, more with each dose. Unlike fire, poison can finish it.

shocked.name: Shocked
shocked.desc: Its next hit lands much harder, and then the shock is gone.

blind.name: Blinded
blind.desc: Blows it aims at one target often miss.

afraid.name: Frightened
afraid.desc: It may cower instead of acting. Badly hurt, it runs for home.

drowsy.name: Drowsy
drowsy.desc: It often nods off instead of acting. Any damage wakes it.

confused.name: Muddled
confused.desc: A blow it aims at one target may land on another foe.

empowered.name: Empowered
empowered.desc: Gathered power: your next damaging spell hits harder.

warded.name: Warded
warded.desc: Your ward is up: blows land much softer, and whoever hits you may be Chilled.

slippery.name: Slippery Goose
slippery.desc: Nothing can hurt her while anyone else in the party has half their health or more, and foes seldom bother trying.
slippery.until: While a friend has half their health

biting.name: Ready to bite
biting.desc: The first foe to strike anyone in the party gets bitten, and Hexed.

dancing.name: Dancing
dancing.desc: Dancing to Thadeous's reel: it loses its turns, one for each on the tag. Blows don't stop it.
dancing.until: Until it has danced its turns away

grudge.name: Grudge
grudge.desc: Any blow it lands on a hero, however small, Hexes it.

wrapped.name: Wrapped up
wrapped.desc: A wool scarf, wound twice: you can't be Chilled.
wrapped.until: For the rest of this fight

cold.name: The cold that stays
cold.desc: {n} cold. It lowers your most health until you rest at a hearth or cairn.
